newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - June 3.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - June 3.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Tuesday:
* On Monday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average ended with moderate losses, falling 41.63 points to 7289.41
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index rose 13.14 points or 1.19 percent to 1,117.97.
* Ringgit quoted at 2.5158/68 a dollar at around 0100 GMT, a little weaker from its Kuala Lumpur ending on Monday at 2.5148/58.

* Timber products firm Jaya Tiasa says nine of 11 timber concession vendors agreed to accept revised price proposals of 388.9 million ringgit for the acquisitions, and two others have given in-principle agreement.
* YTL Power International said it was seeking to list its Chinese and African subsidiaries.

* Westmont Land said negotiations for the sale of its power barge projects were unsuccessful. It has struck a deal to sell a 30 percent stake in Westmont Power (Kenya) Ltd for $6.0 million to a local partner.
* Singapore, Tokyo and Sydney markets were about flat in early trading.
